profile.name: x24-shootout-a
profile.description: PZTestKit (6af6595) + the uninstrumented staged NutritionRevamp copy at 9578eb9, fixture two, admin and bob, Nutrition off, DayLength 1, gclog on - x243a, the scheduler shoot-out at N = 60: an idle baseline and seven schedulers.

meta.staging: staged by Plan 10c Task 0 with no instrument added (the uninstrumented copy)
meta.calibration_note: x242b F: a fed ghost is about one real player's minute, band 0.72..1.0; the fed batch-timed ghost cost was 0.826 ms a run. No ghost.bench in this session.
meta.cost_note: Every reading is cost, not behaviour: the ghosts run copies of the real records against the two real IsoPlayers (their Java writes land on the carriers). The two real players stay on the mod's own drain throughout. No behaviour row rests on this session.
meta.timer_note: getTimestampMs is 1 ms resolution: a frame's busy is a 1 ms reading; every per-run cost is a total over many runs divided by their count.
